text: send a blast upon him: Or, put a spirit into him

By thy servants: Heb. by the hand of thy servants | the tall cedars thereof: Heb. the tallness of the cedars thereof, and the choice of the firr trees thereof | forest of his Carmel: Or, the forest and his fruitful field
beseiged places: Or, fenced and closed

Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps: Or, Hast thou not heard how I have made it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Should I now bring it to be laid waste, and defenced cities to be ruinous heaps?
of small power: Heb. short of hand
the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah: Heb. the escaping of the house of Judah that remaineth
